en.headline: New Wo Zi Shan recreation facilities open in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: The Home Affairs Department said table-tennis tables, fitness equipment and safety matting were in use from Monday morning.
body: New sports and leisure facilities on Wo Zi Shan in Sham Shui Po opened to the public on Monday, the Home Affairs Department said.

The department said the additions include table-tennis tables, a set of fitness equipment and safety matting. It also said signage, railings and shelters had been repaired, and seats added, at suitable and safe spots on the hill. On the first morning, a number of residents were already using the facilities, the department said in a social-media post.

The department described illegal occupation of government land on Wo Zi Shan as a problem in Sham Shui Po for more than a decade. It said clearance of illegal and unsafe structures, facilities and debris was completed in two stages in mid-August, and improvement works followed.

The department did not publish opening hours or a full list of the new equipment. District councillor Chan Lung-kit, quoted by Sing Tao, said the reopening had been promised within two months of the clearance.

zh.headline: 深水埗窩仔山新康體設施星期一開放
zh.dek: 民政事務總署說，乒乓球桌、健身設施和安全地墊今早已有街坊使用。
body: 深水埗窩仔山新增的康體及休憩設施星期一開放公眾使用。民政事務總署表示，設施包括乒乓球桌、一系列健身設施和安全地墊。
署方說，當局8月中分兩階段完成清理窩仔山的違法及不安全構築物、設施及雜物，其後在合適及安全地點推進優化，包括修葺路牌、欄杆及蔭棚，並增設座椅和康體設施。署方在社交網頁表示，開放首天早上已有不少街坊使用。
署方指出，窩仔山非法佔用政府土地是深水埗區十多年來的問題，本屆政府依法清理，同時顧及社區對康體設施的需求。
署方沒有公布開放時間或完整設施清單。星島日報引述深水埗區議員陳龍傑說，清場後兩個月內重開的承諾已經兌現。
